protocol.controls: Absent/empty/0 on diagnostic build exact vs original at matched CPU/full placement. f32 selectively disables MMVQ for layer17 only; copy adds CPU custom identity nodes and transfers, also selected F32; copy/f32 must be raw exact to exclude graph/copy as a necessary cause. gate/up/down/all apply CPU trait Q8_K conversion then dequantization, only single-token exact names, with selected GPU F32. protocol.required_raw_gates: Every201vector finite/nonzero before SHA. Baseline/repeated configs exact; diagnostic OFF CPU/full exact vs BASE. Repeated interventions exact. f32/copy exact. protocol.interpretation: Full-model screen is unchanged and a FAIL remains a FAIL. Changes in argmax/routing or later activations can amplify initial roundoff. Single-projection comparisons and CPU double-quant control bound attribution; numerical improvement is not semantic certification or bit identity. If copy/f32 gate fails, do not attribute all difference reduction solely to quantization. Long nonrepeatable B1 remains ERRORE_BASELINE; no10k or concurrency claims. Compile-time option defaultOFF; invalid diagnostic config aborts graph construction.
